data.one_liner: A Flutter plugin for managing Do Not Disturb settings on Android devices.
data.what_it_does: Allows Flutter apps to check if Do Not Disturb (Zen mode) is enabled, read detailed interruption filter statuses, open DND settings screens, and programmatically set DND modes on Android devices.
use_when: You need to detect if Do Not Disturb is active on Android.
Your app needs to programmatically control or modify DND interruption filters.
You want to direct users to system settings for notification policy access.
avoid_when: You are targeting platforms other than Android and iOS (note that iOS support is limited and ignores configuration calls).
You do not need to interact with system notification policies.
strengths: Clean, enum-based API for handling interruption filter states.
Simple integration with no mandatory permissions for basic read-only status checks.
weaknesses: Modifying DND mode requires special user permission and manifest configuration.
data.setup_notes: For basic read status, no configuration is needed. To set DND mode, add the ACCESS_NOTIFICATION_POLICY permission to AndroidManifest.xml and request notification access from the user.
